summary: The British superstar was performing the second show of his residency at GNP Seguros Stadium on Aug. 1 when he slipped on the rain-slicked stage.
body: Harry Styles  knows how to handle unexpected situations with style, even if it means taking a tumble during a show. The British superstar slipped on the rain-soaked stage floor while performing “Are You Listening Yet?” during the opening of his second night at the GNP Seguros Stadium in Mexico City on Saturday (Aug. 1), as witnessed by Billboard . However, he quickly recovered and kept singing from the floor. body: From career milestones to new releases to major announcements and those little important moments,  Billboard  editors highlight  uplifting moments  in Latin music. Here’s what happened in the Latin music world this week — LAMC (Latin Alternative Music Conference) Edition. Trueno and Milo J Close LAMC With a Full-Capacity SummerStage Show Trueno and Milo J closed LAMC 2026 on Saturday (Aug. 1) with a high-energy performance at Central Park’s SummerStage, where the free concert reached capacity. The Argentine artists brought two distinct but complementary visions to the stage: Trueno with his sharp, old-school rap energy, and Milo J with a soulful, genre-fluid sound rooted in the folkloric traditions of South America. Milo J’s set stood out for its musical range and visual detail. Dressed in brown trousers and a colorful, folkloric vest, the 19-year-old artist performed songs from  La Vida Era Más Corta , including “Recordé” and “Solifican12,” backed by an ensemble featuring flute, charango and percussion galore. His dusky, intimate voice moved between rap cadences and the emotional pull of chacarera, chamamé, zamba and murga, while the crowd sang along. Lat…

title: Phil Collins Recalls Being ‘Blown Away’ by Taylor Swift Before Her Superstardom
summary: Speaking on BBC Radio 2's Tracks of My Years, Collins recalled meeting Swift at a Songwriters Hall of Fame event years ago.
body: Phil Collins has praised Taylor Swift , saying the pop superstar “deserves” her place as “the hugest thing in the world” after being “blown away completely” the first time he saw her perform 15 years ago. Speaking to Vernon Kay on BBC Radio 2’s Tracks of My Years , Collins recalled meeting Swift at a Songwriters Hall of Fame event years ago, before she reached her current level of fame, and watching her perform her song “White Horse.” “This very nice lady then got up on stage with a guitar and sang ‘White Horse,’ and it blew me away completely,” he said. “Not only was the song great, and the sentiment of the song really got me, but she sang it beautifully. And it was just so simple, you know, her on a guitar.” Collins said he has “always had a soft spot” for the track since. “I’m so pleased that she’s the hugest thing in the world now because she kind of feels like she deserves it,” he said. “I mean it’s easy to knock someone that’s got so much success, but I think she really deserves it.” Elsewhere in the interview, Collins revealed…

title: Kylie Minogue Joins Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds for ‘Where the Wild Roses Grow’ in Brighton
summary: The duet marked the first time the pair had performed the song together live since 2019.
body: Two Australian icons shared a stage in Brighton, England, on Friday (Aug. 1) as Kylie Minogue joined Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds during the band’s concert at Preston Park to perform their 1995 duet “Where the Wild Roses Grow.” Minogue appeared midway through the Bad Seeds’ set for the murder-ballad duet, marking the first time the pair had performed the song together live since 2019, when Cave surprised the crowd during Minogue’s legends slot at Glastonbury. Before that, the two sang it together in 2018 — the last time the Bad Seeds played the song live — as well as in 2013 and on several occasions in the mid-1990s following the release of Murder Ballads . View this post on Instagram Minogue reflected on the reunion in an Instagram post after the show. “I’ll forever be your Wild Rose @nickcaveofficial,” she wrote, thanking the Bad Seeds and calling it a “wonderful crowd, wonderful night.” She also credited her white lace dress, complete with wild-rose embellishments, to Susie Cave — Nick Cave’s wife and the designer behind the fashion label The Vampire’s Wife. title: The Best Moments So Far From Lollapalooza 2026
summary: A Charli xcx and Lorde reunion, John Summit's homecoming and Sombr's collab with 5 Seconds of Summer led night one.
body: All eyes in the music world are on Chicago this weekend, as Grant Park plays host to another year of Lollapalooza . With the weather looking uncertain for the festival’s later days, thousands flocked to the Chicago Riverwalk on a sun-kissed Thursday afternoon (July 30) to kick off Lolla.  Performances began around noon CT across nine different stages and wrapped up with Lorde making her return to the Lolla stage for the first time since 2017 with Chicago’s own John Summit co-headlining on opposite ends of the park.  The rest of the day saw performances from Filipino boy band SB19, who made history as the first P-pop group to perform at Lolla, as well as Bella Kay, Blood Orange, Little Simz, Boys Noize, Audrey Hobert, Sombr, 5 Seconds of Summer and Wet Leg. A jam-packed weekend remains on tap, with anticipated headlining sets from Charli xcx , who made a guest appearance during Lorde’s performance, as well as Olivia Dean , Tate McRae , The xx, Smashing Pumpkins and Jennie. There was chatter on the festival grounds from fans speculating that A-listers Olivia Rodrigo , who was allegedly spotted at Chicago’s O’Hare Airport, and Ariana Grande could be popping up. title: Billie Eilish’s ‘Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour’ Film Hits Streaming This Week
summary: The concert film, made with James Cameron, debuts on streaming on Aug. 6 via Paramount+.
body: Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live) , Billie Eilish ’s concert film about her arena tour in support of her 2024 album Hit Me Hard and Soft , debuts on streaming exclusively on Paramount+ on Thursday (Aug. 6) in the United States, the streaming service announced Thursday (July 30). Eilish premiered the film, which had a 3D theatrical release via Paramount Pictures, on May 6 at Los Angeles’ Fox Westwood Theater. Director James Cameron — as well as Eilish’s parents and brother Finneas, and her partner Nat Wolff — joined the star on the red carpet . It opened in theaters May 8. title: Patti Smith Reflects On Meeting Pope Leo XIV: ‘A Moment That Will Forever Produce a Smile’
summary: He was familiar with Smith's tune "Wave." “That was marvelous,” he said.
body: Rock legend Patti Smith was giddy and almost at a loss for words when she met Friday (July 31) with Pope Leo XIV. Related Pope Leo XIV & Bad Bunny Held a Private Meeting in Madrid Kylie Minogue Joins Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds for 'Where the Wild Roses Grow' in Brighton Parker McCollum Welcomes Second Baby With Wife Hallie Ray “Hi,” she said softly as she sat down across from Leo at his desk in the Apostolic Palace. Post-meeting, on Instagram, she had a bit more to say: “This is a moment that shall forever produce a smile,” she wrote of the encounter. Wearing a crucifix necklace and hair in her trademark braids, Smith has become an increasingly visible presence at the Vatican thanks to her friendship with the Rev. Antonio Spadaro, undersecretary in the Vatican’s culture ministry. She has said that while she is not Catholic, she was drawn in particular to Pope Francis and his “gentle, open, and steadfast sense of humanity.” She also had a thing for Pope John Paul I: Her 1979 tune “Wave” is about a make-believe conversation with the pope who had just died after a 33-day papacy.
